name: Mathias Shaw
summary: In Old Town, Mathias Shaw directs SI:7, Stormwind's covert intelligence agency. From the shadows, he sends spies and scouts to guard the realm against conspiracies within and horrors beyond.

sections.title: Master of SI:7
sections.body: Mathias Shaw leads Stormwind's spies and assassins from SI:7's hidden headquarters behind the barracks in Old Town. His covert network reaches across the Eastern Kingdoms and beyond. Loyal to the House of Wrynn, Shaw weighs every threat with care. He trusts unseen daggers and stolen messages to defend Stormwind as much as armor and palace guards.

sections.title: Shadow of VanCleef
sections.body: Mathias Shaw once called Edwin VanCleef a childhood companion. Shaw trained VanCleef in stealth and assassination, hoping the gifted stonemason would serve the kingdom beside him. But after the Stonemasons Guild was cast out following Stormwind's rebuilding, VanCleef turned those lessons against the crown. Shaw now directs surveillance and infiltration across Westfall to break his old friend's rebellion.

sections.title: Eyes Across the Kingdoms
sections.body: Mathias Shaw watches threats beyond the unrest in Westfall and Elwynn. Reports of strange Forsaken operations in the Eastern Plaguelands led him to send five of his finest agents to investigate. Only one came back alive, babbling about "Nathanos" and a "Blightcaller" before dying in his sleep. Shaw now depends on trusted champions to go where his scouts vanish and uncover the dangers gathering at the kingdom's borders.

faq.answer: Mathias Shaw leads SI:7, Stormwind's intelligence service and guild of assassins. From Old Town, he directs the kingdom's spies and covert defense under the throne's authority.

faq.q: Where can Mathias Shaw be found?
faq.answer: Mathias Shaw can be found inside SI:7's headquarters in Stormwind City's Old Town, behind the military barracks.

faq.q: What is his connection to Edwin VanCleef?
faq.answer: Shaw's connection to Edwin VanCleef is one of Westfall's secrets. He records SI:7's knowledge of the Stonemasons Guild in a report for Gryan Stoutmantle. Follow the Defias Brotherhood to its end to learn how closely the two are bound.
SI:7 is Stormwind's leading intelligence organization. Its agents gather information, conduct espionage, and carry out covert assassinations to protect the kingdom and Alliance interests.

faq.q: Why is Mathias Shaw interested in Westfall?
faq.answer: Shaw is interested in Westfall because it is the Defias Brotherhood's stronghold. He keeps agents there to watch the rebels and disrupt their plots against Stormwind.

faq.q: What happened to the agents Shaw sent to the Plaguelands?
faq.answer: Shaw sent five agents to investigate suspicious Forsaken movements in the Eastern Plaguelands. Four never returned. The sole survivor babbled about "Nathanos" and a "Blightcaller" before dying in his sleep days later.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can look to Mathias Shaw as a master of human roguecraft. Alliance rogues are often sent to him for advanced tactical assignments and specialty poisons.
As an Alliance member, you can count on Shaw to gather military intelligence for Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and the boy-king Anduin. His spies guard the kingdom against subversion.
As a human, you can see the Defias Brotherhood's revolt as part of the bitter division in the Kingdom of Stormwind after its reconstruction.
